description: JStock is open showing the Stock Watchlist tab with the following US stocks already added: AAPL (Apple Inc.), MSFT (Microsoft Corp.), GOOGL (Alphabet Inc.), AMZN (Amazon.com Inc.), and NVDA (NVIDIA Corp.). Your task is to add Tesla (TSLA) to the watchlist. To add a stock: click on the 'Stock' input text field near the top of the watchlist, type 'TSLA' — as you type, an autocomplete dropdown appears showing matching tickers — then press Enter to confirm and add the first matching result (TSLA / Tesla Inc.). After adding, TSLA should appear as a new row in the watchlist.
